data.one_liner: A Dart and Flutter wrapper for the DiceBear API to generate unique avatar profile pictures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully-typed wrapper for the DiceBear API to generate unique avatar profile pictures based on seeds. Supports 30+ avatar styles with style-specific customization and can output SVG URLs, rendered Flutter widgets, or raw SVG bytes.
use_when: You need to generate unique, deterministic avatar profile pictures from user IDs or seeds.
You want to use the DiceBear API with type safety and compile-time validation in Flutter.
avoid_when: You need an offline-only avatar generation solution that does not rely on network requests or remote API fetching.
You need to manipulate complex vector graphics beyond simple avatar rendering.
strengths: Full type safety with dedicated classes for each style option and compile-time validation.
Supports 30+ unique DiceBear avatar styles and fine-grained customization.
Flexible output options including SVG URLs, raw bytes, and direct Flutter widgets.
weaknesses: Relies on a network wrapper to fetch avatars from the DiceBear API.
Limited to DiceBear avatar styles and options.
